description: #177: the testenv guard was fail-OPEN because Next loads `.env.local`/`.env.development.local` BEFORE `.env`; stack.sh placed a safe `.env` and guard scanned only `.env`, but ~/ghq/mootech-fe/.env.local points PROD (Supabase DATABASE_URL + onrender NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) → it WON over the safe .env and guard reported 'safe' while the app read prod. Fix: stack.sh `shadow_others` moves EVERY other `.env*` aside (backed up → *.testenv-shadowed) via a GLOB (whole-space, not a memorized list) so `.env` is the only active env; guard scans the WHOLE active set; guard now also scans NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. #178: write_breadcrumb printed the backup path UNCONDITIONALLY, so the .env.disabled marker advertised a backup that was never made — fixed with test -f (states 'NO backup was made' when none exists). Teeth (sandbox, bash 3.2, neg-control-first): guard.test.sh 12/12 (adds the #177 NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL cases); full up run shadows prod .env.local/.env.development.local → only local .env active → guard passes; MUTANT disable shadow_others → prod .env.local stays active → guard-active-set REFUSES (neon/supabase/onrender) → rollback CAUGHT; restore un-shadows; bazi (no .env) → marker 'NO backup was made' (honest). Script-only, no runtime touched. gate_layer=infra/shell.
